flags: Powerups page was last updated Nov 2025 (before City Never Sleeps) — the 5:00 / every 5 min timing may have changed.
Unstable Rift timing varies by about ±1 minute per the wiki, so its countdown is approximate.
Sinner's Sacrifice: the Sep 29 patch says it now has 'variable timings to get the bonus' without details.
Respawn before 5:00 isn't documented; the wiki gives 8s at 5:00 and interpolates linearly between its listed points.

notes: +10s if a non-hero unit kills you with no enemy hero involved.
Being killed while far richer than the enemy team (15–30% above their average) after 10:00 adds 6–22s.
When a team kills the first Patron phase, defenders' long respawns are cut by 20s.

events.name: Mid-Boss is alive
events.what: Spawned from the start. After each kill it returns in 7 min, then 6, then 5 (use the Mid-Boss button to track it). Kill reward: souls, 2 permanent buffs each, and 3 Rejuvenator crystals — heavy-melee each one.

events.name: Trooper wave
events.what: A new wave every 30s until 20:00, every 25s until 35:00, then every 20s.

events.name: Small Haunts (Tier I)
events.what: First jungle camps spawn. Each camp respawns 1:25 after you clear it.

events.name: Crates & Buff Containers
events.what: Most crates and Buff Containers (golden statues) appear; each respawns 3 min after it's broken. Crates give souls; containers have a 50% chance to drop a permanent stat booklet.

events.name: Bridge powerups
events.what: Powerups appear on the bridges near the Urn spots. Heavy-melee to claim. Lasts 160s. At 5:00 the type is random; at 10:00 you get the other two types.

events.name: Medium Haunts (Tier II)
events.what: Tier II camps spawn. Respawn 4:50 after clearing.

events.name: Tunnel & Bell Tower loot
events.what: Tunnel crates/containers (respawn 5 min) and the crates on top of the Bell Tower and in Sunken Plaza (respawn 3 min) appear.

events.name: Waves get a melee trooper
events.what: Waves change from 3 ranged + 1 medic to 2 ranged, 1 melee and 1 medic.

events.name: Large Haunts (Tier III)
events.what: The biggest camps spawn. Respawn 5:35 after clearing.

events.name: Sinner's Sacrifice
events.what: Slot-machine vaults unlock. Light melee = 1 buff, heavy melee = 4 buffs on the jackpot. Respawns 5 min after being broken.

events.name: Soul Urn
events.what: Spawns next to a bridge, alternating Yellow / Green side (first one is always Yellow). Carry it to the drop-off on the far side: 250 souls +70 per minute for the team, plus 4 random permanent buffs. Its value starts decaying after 45s of carrying.

events.name: Buff Container above Mid-Boss
events.what: The container in the room above the Mid-Boss pit appears (respawns 3 min after breaking).

events.name: Unstable Rift
events.what: Announced to everyone, opens 20s later. Stand in it to capture (12s; faster for the team that's behind). The winner gets Rift Troopers pushing for them. ~±1 min variance.

events.name: Lane Guardians at their weakest
events.what: Guardian damage resist falls from +50% at 0:00 to −50% at 12:00 — pushing towers is much easier from now on.

events.name: Waves every 25s
events.what: Trooper waves speed up. Respawn is now ~38s; dying hurts more.

events.name: Troopers gain 20% spirit resist
events.what: Clearing waves with abilities gets slightly harder (70% at 50:00).

events.name: Waves every 20s · +50% trooper HP
events.what: Late game: waves are fast and tanky. Respawn ~78s — one bad death can lose the game.

events.name: Respawn ~85s (cap 90s)
events.what: Fight together and around Rejuvenator timings.

phases.name: Laning
do: Last-hit troopers, then shoot the soul orb that pops out to secure it. Shoot enemy orbs to deny them.
Spend souls whenever you're back at a shop — unspent souls do nothing.
When your wave is pushed in, break nearby crates or clear Small Haunts (from 2:00) and come back.
Grab a bridge powerup at 5:00 if it's close and safe (heavy melee).
avoid: Chasing kills under the enemy Guardian.
Fighting with no stamina left to dash away.

phases.name: Mid game
do: Be near the Soul Urn at 10:00 and every 5 min after (Yellow side first, then alternating).
Push Guardians after 12:00 — they're at their weakest. Each Guardian unlocks that lane's Walker.
Each Walker your team kills gives everyone an extra item slot.
Contest the Unstable Rift (~11:00, then ~every 7 min) when the team is nearby.
Take the Mid-Boss only when the enemy team is dead or far away — and break all 3 crystals.
avoid: Farming alone while your team fights 5v6.
Starting Mid-Boss with low HP and no vision.

phases.name: Late game
phases.goal: Don't throw. Every death costs over a minute.
do: Move as a group; let the wave reach the objective before you hit it.
Base Guardians (2 per lane) must fall before the Shrines can be hit. Both Shrines down → the Patron becomes vulnerable.
At half HP the Patron becomes the Weakened Patron — it can only be damaged from inside its pit, and defenders in the pit make it resistant.
After a won team fight, push. After a lost one, defend and wait for respawns.
avoid: Fighting the enemy while they have Rejuvenator credits and you don't.
